name: RA_RECURRING_BILL_PLANS
description: Recurring Bill Plan stores the information about recurring bills such as amount per bill, number of bills, and first invoice date.

columns.name: RECURRING_BILL_PLAN_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the recurring bill plan

columns.name: PERIODICITY_CODE
columns.description: Period of the recurring invoice. Valid values are DAY, WEEK, MONTH, QUARTER, YEAR.

columns.name: FIRST_INVOICE_DATE
columns.description: Transaction date of the first invoice for recurring invoices.

columns.name: SECOND_INVOICE_DATE
columns.description: Transaction date of the second invoice for recurring invoices, if the first invoice was for a partial period.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_CONTRACTED_PERIODS
columns.description: Number of recurring invoices to issue.

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Recurring transaction line amount for recurring invoices.

columns.name: FIRST_OVERRIDE_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Number indicating the period that has an override amount. For example, the first invoice is for period 1, the second invoice is for period 2, and so on.

columns.name: FIRST_OVERRIDE_AMOUNT
columns.description: The override amount for the period indicated in First Override Period.

columns.name: FIRST_OVERRIDE_QUANTITY
columns.description: Override quantity for the period indicated in the first override period.

columns.name: SECOND_OVERRIDE_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Number indicating the period that has an override amount. For example, the first invoice is for period 1, the second invoice is for period 2, and so on.

columns.name: SECOND_OVERRIDE_AMOUNT
columns.description: The override amount for the period indicated in Second Override Period.

columns.name: SECOND_OVERRIDE_QUANTITY
columns.description: Override quantity for the period indicated in the second override period.

columns.name: THIRD_OVERRIDE_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Number indicating the period that has an override amount. For example, the first invoice is for period 1, the second invoice is for period 2, and so on.

columns.name: THIRD_OVERRIDE_AMOUNT
columns.description: The override amount for the period indicated in Third Override Period.

columns.name: THIRD_OVERRIDE_QUANTITY
columns.description: Override quantity for the period indicated in the third override period.

columns.name: FOURTH_OVERRIDE_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Number indicating the period that has an override amount. For example, the first invoice is for period 1, the second invoice is for period 2, and so on.

columns.name: FOURTH_OVERRIDE_AMOUNT
columns.description: The override amount for the period indicated in Fourth Override Period.

columns.name: FOURTH_OVERRIDE_QUANTITY
columns.description: Override quantity for the period indicated in the fourth override period.

columns.name: FIFTH_OVERRIDE_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Number indicating the period that has an override amount. For example, the first invoice is for period 1, the second invoice is for period 2, and so on.

columns.name: FIFTH_OVERRIDE_AMOUNT
columns.description: The override amount for the period indicated in Fifth Override Period.

columns.name: FIFTH_OVERRIDE_QUANTITY
columns.description: Override quantity for the period indicated in the fifth override period.

columns.name: FIRST_BILLING_PERIOD_START_DT
columns.description: The start date of the billing period on the first invoice, that is, the contract start date.

columns.name: SECOND_BILLING_PERIOD_START_DT
columns.description: The start date of the billing period on the second invoice, if the first invoice did not cover a full billing period.

columns.name: CANCELED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of a canceled recurring bill plan. Valid values are Y, N, and null. Null is the same as N.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CONTRACT_LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Either the original item amount on the contract or the new item amount after any credits on the contract, if the transaction line is associated with a contract.

columns.name: CONTRACT_LINE_QUANTITY
columns.description: Either the original item quantity on the contract or the new item quantity after any credits on the contract, if the transaction line is associated with a contract.

columns.name: CONTRACT_LINE_UNITPRICE
columns.description: Either the original item unit price on the contract or the new item unit price after any credits on the contract, if the transaction line is associated with a contract.
